**Briefly make comments on contributions of your teammates to the project. If you gave less than a perfect grade, please justify your evaluation below.**

**Julie Diaz(90%):** Julie led the research and background section of the project, contributing the introduction, store background, target customer segment identification, and customer goals analysis for both CPP Students and Local Community Members in GP1. She also delivered Slides 1–3 of the proposal presentation and the product selection list for GP3. Her work was consistently organized and delivered on time, providing the foundational research that the rest of the group built upon.

**Cecilia Espina(90%):** Cecilia completed the six-stage customer journey map for both target segments in GP1 — one of the most detailed and labor-intensive deliverables in the project. She also contributed the Business and Project Objectives slides for the proposal and built the product feed spreadsheet with all required Google Merchant Center fields along with rewritten product titles for GP3. Her work was thorough, detailed, and submitted on time.

**Angela Qain(80%):** Angela was assigned the pain points and omnichannel opportunities section of GP1, Slides 8–10 of the proposal presentation including final slide deck assembly, and the feed quality diagnosis and retail media strategy for GP3. While her assigned sections were ultimately completed, Angela consistently missed internal group deadlines throughout the midterm period. This created a compressed timeline for the rest of the group to review, revise, and finalize deliverables before submission, placing additional pressure on other members during the assembly process.

**Danielle Meza — Self (90%):** My contributions included the visual journey map built in RStudio using ggplot2, QMD setup and compilation for GP1, GitHub repo management and GitHub Pages publishing, Slides 6–7 of the proposal presentation with speaker scripts, all ten product descriptions for the GP3 product feed, and the image readiness assessment for all ten products. I met all internal group deadlines for my assigned sections and supported the group's final QMD compilation and submission process.
